prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, inside a deep 1930s brick bank vault under the city, a row of caged bulbs along the ceiling, an open iron furnace door in the back wall glowing orange, and a mountain of bundles of blank green paper money with no printing, each tied with a rubber band, piled almost to the ceiling. The camera low at the foot of a long wooden plank: the iron wheel and handles of a wheelbarrow heaped with bundles fill the near foreground. The plank rises steeply away up the side of the money mountain, and gangsters in pinstripe trousers, waistcoats and rolled shirt-sleeves, sweating: a fat one with a scar through his top lip, a thin bald one with big ears, a young one with slicked red hair and freckles toil up it pushing barrows piled high, bundles tumbling off. High in the wall, a narrow barred window at pavement level onto the snowy street, cold blue, the boots and shabby trouser hems of a queue of people shuffling past outside. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the caged bulbs, the orange furnace door and the lit paper edges of the bundles. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
